definition: A helpful message shown when a view has no items, explaining why it is empty and what the person can do next.
whenToUse: A new account with no projects

notConfusedWith.difference: Represents content still loading; an empty state appears after loading confirms there are no items.

prompts.short: Add an empty state explaining why no items appear and offering a next step.
prompts.detailed: Add a clear empty-state heading, a short explanation, and a relevant next action. Distinguish no content from loading or errors. Use a real link or button with visible focus and a 44px target; hide any decorative illustration from screen readers.
